Our Story

How we brewed

DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. lives where specialty coffee meets street fashion. “Drip” is for your streetwear essentials; “Drop” is for the coffee you’ll enjoy down to the last drop.

DripDrop started in October 2026 as an HTML website project, built by a group of IT students from the University of Eastern Pangasinan. Then we saw what it could be: a place for good coffee, streetwear, and the people who live for both.

We’re more than a cafe or a clothing label. We’re a culture where you can express your style, discover your taste, and find your people.

We make coffee that slaps and clothes you can hustle in.

Terms & Policies

General Conditions For the 10% off every time you show up in DripDrop For The Cup & Fit Bundle

General Conditions

  • All promotions are valid only at participating DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. locations.
  • Customers are encouraged to confirm eligibility, exclusions, and current promotional details with store staff before completing a purchase.
  • DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. reserves the right to amend these terms and conditions when necessary, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

For the 10% off every time you show up in DripDrop

  • Customers are entitled to 10% off eligible purchases when wearing official DripDrop merchandise during an in-store order.
  • Customers must wear their DripDrop merchandise at the time of purchase to qualify for the discount.
  • The discount applies only to eligible items and is subject to in-store verification by staff.
  • The discount cannot be combined with other promotions, discounts, or special offers unless otherwise stated.
  • The discount has no cash value and is non-transferable.
  • DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. reserves the right to exclude specific products from the promotion and to modify or end the offer when necessary

For The Cup & Fit Bundle

  • The promotion offers a bundle featuring a selected DripDrop beverage and an eligible streetwear item.
  • Bundle inclusions and prices are subject to availability and may vary depending on the selected items.
  • The promotional price applies only to qualifying drink-and-apparel combinations.
  • Items included in the bundle cannot be substituted for other products unless approved by DripDrop staff.
  • The bundle offer cannot be combined with other promotions or discounts unless otherwise stated.
  • All purchases are subject to product availability and applicable store policies.
  • DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. reserves the right to modify or discontinue the bundle promotion when necessary.

Refund and Return Policy

At DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co., we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. Please review our refund and return guidelines below.

1. Food and Beverage Purchases

  • All coffee and other prepared beverages are generally non-refundable once prepared and served.
  • If you receive an incorrect order or a product with a quality issue, please notify our staff as soon as possible so we can assess the concern and offer an appropriate resolution.

2. Apparel and Merchandise

  • Unworn, unused, and unwashed apparel may be eligible for return or exchange, provided the items are in their original condition with tags and proof of purchase.
  • Requests must be made within seven (7) days of purchase.
  • Items that have been worn, washed, damaged after purchase, or altered by the customer are not eligible for return or exchange, except where required by applicable law.
  • Sale items and promotional merchandise may be subject to additional restrictions, which will be communicated at the time of purchase.

3. Promotional Purchases

  • Items purchased through promotional offers or bundles are subject to the applicable promotion terms.
  • If only part of a bundle is returned, any refund will be calculated according to the applicable bundle terms and the value of the items retained.
  • Promotional discounts cannot be refunded or exchanged for cash.
  • Any return or refund involving a discounted purchase must comply with applicable consumer protection laws.

4. Refund Processing

  • Approved refunds will be issued using the original payment method whenever possible.
  • Processing times may vary depending on the payment provider.
  • Proof of purchase, such as an official receipt or order confirmation, may be required.
  • Exchanges, replacements, or other resolutions may be offered where appropriate and permitted by law.

5. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items

  • If you receive defective merchandise or an incorrect order, please contact us promptly and provide your receipt and, when applicable, photos of the issue. We will review the request and determine an appropriate resolution in accordance with applicable consumer protection laws.

6. Contact Us

  • For refund, return, or exchange inquiries, please contact DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. through our official customer service channels.
  • DripDrop Cafe & Clothing Co. reserves the right to update this policy, subject to applicable laws and regulations. Nothing in this policy limits any consumer rights provided by law.
